aliases: delta u equals q minus w
change in internal energy equals net heat entering the system minus net work done by the system
negative_phrases: delta u equals q plus w
change in internal energy equals net heat entering the system minus net work done on the system
rows.scope_review: The sign convention is heat entering positive and work done by the system positive. Do not substitute a work-on-system convention without changing the sign.

aliases: the partial derivative of u with respect to t equals alpha times the second partial derivative of u with respect to x
the first partial derivative of temperature with respect to time equals thermal diffusivity times the second partial derivative of temperature with respect to position
negative_phrases: the partial derivative of u with respect to t equals alpha times the first partial derivative of u with respect to x
the partial derivative of u with respect to t equals alpha times the square of the partial derivative of u with respect to x
rows.scope_review: The time derivative is first order and the spatial derivative is second order, not the square of a first derivative. Alpha is thermal diffusivity, not conductivity alone.

aliases: p v equals n r t
absolute pressure times volume equals amount in moles times the molar gas constant times absolute temperature
negative_phrases: p v equals n r divided by t
absolute pressure times volume equals mass times the molar gas constant times absolute temperature
rows.scope_review: Pressure times volume equals the product of molar amount, molar gas constant and absolute temperature. The literal aliases retain familiar spoken forms.

aliases: u equals three halves times n times r times t
internal energy equals three halves times amount in moles times the molar gas constant times absolute temperature
negative_phrases: u equals five halves times n times r times t
u equals three halves times n times r divided by t
rows.scope_review: The factor is three halves, multiplying the amount in moles, molar gas constant and absolute temperature. This is the stored monatomic translational model, not an assertion for arbitrary gases.

aliases: q equals m times c times delta t
heat transferred equals mass times specific heat capacity times the change in temperature
negative_phrases: q equals m times c times t
heat transferred equals mass times specific heat capacity divided by the change in temperature
rows.scope_review: The temperature factor is the signed temperature change, not absolute temperature. Use the process-specific heat capacity specified by the mathematical conditions.

aliases: delta l equals alpha times l sub zero times delta t
change in length equals the linear thermal expansion coefficient times initial length times the change in temperature
negative_phrases: delta l equals alpha times l sub zero times t
change in length equals the volumetric thermal expansion coefficient times initial length times the change in temperature
rows.scope_review: The product uses the linear coefficient, initial length and signed temperature change. The equality retains its first-order approximation conditions.
